text: 若队伍中有人需要治疗，可以为每人恢复1点生命值。沿河前进，前往60。尽可能登高，前往552。以群山为地标，前往56。沿着林线前进，前往233。深入森林探索，前往461。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 158
text: If any of your party require healing, you may restore 1 hit point each. To follow the river, go to 60. To gain elevation where you can, go to 552. To use the mountains as a landmark, go to 56. To hug the tree line, go to 233. To explore the deep woods, go to 461.
